newsitem.title: USA: Goodyear Q1 worldwide tire unit sales up.
newsitem.headline: Goodyear Q1 worldwide tire unit sales up.

text.p: Goodyear Tire & Rubber Co said on Monday its worldwide tire unit sales in the quarter rose 3.6 percent over 1996 on increased volume in all regions.
Sales for the quarter were $3.23 billion, compared to $3.25 billion in the 1996 quarter and were adversely affected by strengthening of the U.S. dollar and competitive pricing, Goodyear said.

In Europe, sales of $764.5 million for the first quarter increased from $763.8 million in 1996, and operating income was $79.6 million compared with $79.4 million in last year's quarter, the company said.

Results reflected unfavorable effects of currency translation and competitive pricing pressures, the company said. Operating margin was flat at 10.4 percent compared with the year-ago period, the company said.
First quarter results include the company's ownership interest in tire and engineered products operations in South Africa, the company said.
